analyst.summary: Religare Enterprises is a financial holding company whose real value driver is its health insurance business (Care Health, about three-quarters of revenue) - a segment benefiting from India's genuine, structural rise in health-insurance adoption - alongside smaller lending and broking arms. The company has a complicated history, including a past fraud episode in its NBFC arm and a more recent contest over board control, and different data sources currently disagree sharply on how profitable the business really is (return-on-equity readings range from roughly 3% to over 40% depending on the measurement window). At around 100 times trailing earnings, a great deal of confidence is being priced in for a business whose recent profitability is not yet a clean, settled number. We rate this a Hold but are flagging it for the desk given the scale of the data disagreement and the company's history.
